privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: Privacy policy for Iltonggi (일통기 · 一統記) — neither the app nor the website collects personal information.
privacy.callout: The Iltonggi app and this website do not collect your personal information.

p: Iltonggi ("the App") is a mobile game operated by an individual developer, Davy Kim (ipe Studio). The App has no accounts or sign-in, and it does not collect or send to any server any personal information such as your name, email, contact details, location or device identifiers. Your game progress and settings are stored only on your device and are deleted when you delete the App.
The App contains no advertising, analytics or tracking SDKs.

The iltonggi.ipe.rest website uses no cookies and includes no analytics or advertising tags. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, so ordinary web request information (such as your IP address) may be sent to Google. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, and GitHub's server-log policies apply.

Because we collect no personal information, we have nothing to share with or sell to third parties. The App is distributed through the Apple App Store; information related to downloads is handled by Apple under Apple's privacy policy.

To request access, correction, deletion or suspension of processing of your personal information, or to ask any question, write to {mail}. Note that because we hold no personal information, there may be nothing to act on.
The App is not directed to children under 14 (or the minimum age in your region), and it collects no personal information from any user.
- Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: 1833-6972 · kopico.go.kr
- Personal Information Infringement Report Center: 118 · privacy.kisa.or.kr
- Supreme Prosecutors' Office Cybercrime Division: 1301 · National Police Agency Cyber Bureau: 182
If the App later adds accounts, payments or online features that change what is collected, we will update this policy first and change the effective date.

We may improve or change the App's features, or stop providing it. Important changes will be announced in the App Store description or on this site.

The App is provided as it is. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from your use of the App. The App is a creative work inspired by Korea's Three Kingdoms era and may differ from historical fact.
